icons.label: RELAY TOWER 01
icons.detail: Uplink relay carrying colony traffic back to the Hermes orbiter. Signal margin is thin after the dust storm.

icons.label: SUPPLY CACHE 02
icons.detail: Sealed pod from the second drop. Manifest lists coolant cells and two hardlight cutters.

icons.label: LANDING PAD 03
icons.detail: Primary pad for the crawler shuttle. Weather line is green but the north approach is drifting.

icons.label: ICE VEIN 04
icons.detail: Subsurface ice signature confirmed by the survey drone. Extraction rights belong to the Ares Logistics Guild.

icons.label: DISTRESS BEACON
icons.detail: Repeating civilian distress ping. No transponder ID. Hellforge crews have passed close twice without reporting.

icons.label: WEATHER MAST
icons.detail: Mast is reading a dust front building forty klicks west. Crossing the basin after 18:00 is not advised.

icons.label: WRECKED ROVER
icons.detail: Survey rover from the first expedition. Rear axle is sheared. Parts may still be salvageable.

icons.label: D3SO FORWARD CAMP
icons.detail: Forward camp and crew muster point. Trading post opens once the crawler is parked within 200 m.
